description: This file declares the RemoveSource class, which is a task related to removing a media source in a GStreamer-based media player context. It includes class members and constructor/destructor declarations, and references external interfaces and context objects.

classes.name: RemoveSource
classes.description: A class representing a task to remove a media source in the GStreamer media player context.

methods.name: RemoveSource
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the RemoveSource task with the given context, client, gstWrapper, and media source type.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the task to remove the media source.
